description: PlutusV2 minting policy exercising byteStringToInteger, a V3-era builtin retroactively added to the PlutusV2 cost model. This is cardano-node-tests' own compiled artifact (plutus_common.BYTE_STRING_ROUNDTRIP_V2_REC / BYTE_STRING_ROUNDTRIP_V2_COST), used by tests_conway/test_update_plutusv2_builtins.py (via tests_plutus_v2/mint_raw.py::check_missing_builtin) to assert the builtin becomes usable once costModels.PlutusV2 grows to 185 entries. Vendored per the dugite #969/#970 no-third-party-compiler convention: this is IntersectMBO's own checked-in test data, not something dugite or Aiken compiled. Used by tx-zoo 18l-v2-script-v3-builtins.sh (#1033).
cborHex_wrapping_note: This cborHex came from cardano-node-tests' OWN cardano-cli text envelope, already double-wrapped the way cardano-cli expects (an outer CBOR bstr(34) containing an inner bstr(32) of the flat-encoded script). Unlike plutus-examples.json's script_hex (a BARE flat-script hex that lib/build-plutus.sh's _wrap_cbor_bytes must wrap once more), this value must be dropped into the envelope's cborHex field VERBATIM -- re-wrapping it would produce a triple-wrapped script cardano-cli still loads, under yet another wrong hash (the #836/#969 vendoring trap).
